answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in opal, expire in yarrow, and ferrous lists each expiry. An copycat running 52 aliases as a result needs 134 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 863 identities would post 4744 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
